reason: I shop when Eid, Ramadan or a wedding is coming up, and nothing is on my calendar in November, so I'd probably drive past on my way to Hillcroft and maybe pop in to look. For weddings and henna nights I usually wear shalwar kameez or something desi anyway, so thobes and jalabiyas aren't what I go to first.
objection: Will the abayas and thobes actually come long enough for me and fit right, or will I be paying $75 to $80 and then paying for alterations on top of that?
would_change_my_mind: If I had a wedding or Eid coming up and they had pieces in a proper long length that I could try on and take home the same day, with the 15% off still going.
